# FinCalcHub

> Free personal-finance calculators and educational guides for the USA, UK, and South Africa. Every calculator runs in your browser — no signup, no data leaves your device.

## Calculators

- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://finncalc.com/compound-interest/): Daily, monthly, or yearly compounding with optional monthly contributions.
- [Retirement Savings Calculator](https://finncalc.com/retirement-savings/): How much you need to retire and whether your savings rate is on track.
- [Investment Growth Calculator](https://finncalc.com/investment-growth/): Project a portfolio's future value with regular contributions and an expected return.
- [Inflation Calculator](https://finncalc.com/inflation-impact/): What today's money will be worth after years of inflation.
- [Take-Home Pay Calculator](https://finncalc.com/take-home-pay/): Real salary after income tax, National Insurance, FICA, or UIF in the UK, USA, or South Africa.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://finncalc.com/mortgage/): Monthly payment, total interest, and full amortisation. UK / US / SA bond conventions.
- [Loan Payoff Calculator](https://finncalc.com/loan-payoff/): Exact payoff date and total interest, with the savings from extra payments.
- [Credit Card Payoff Calculator](https://finncalc.com/credit-card-payoff/): Debt-free date and the real cost of minimum payments.
- [Budget Planner (50/30/20 Rule)](https://finncalc.com/budget/): Plan needs, wants, and savings; see surplus or shortfall instantly.
- [Savings Goal Calculator](https://finncalc.com/savings-goal/): How long it takes to reach any target at your current saving rate.
- [Emergency Fund Calculator](https://finncalc.com/emergency-fund/): Right-size your cash buffer based on monthly essentials.
- [Net Worth Calculator](https://finncalc.com/net-worth/): Total assets minus liabilities, with benchmarks by age and region.
- [401(k) Calculator](https://finncalc.com/401k-calculator/): Project your 401(k) balance with employer match and 2026 IRS limits ($23,500 base / $31,000 catch-up). USA.
- [Roth IRA Calculator](https://finncalc.com/roth-ira-calculator/): Tax-free retirement growth with 2026 limits ($7,000 / $8,000 catch-up) and MAGI phase-out for single, MFJ, MFS. USA.
- [Student Loan Repayment Calculator](https://finncalc.com/student-loan-calculator/): UK Plan 1/2/4/5/9 income-contingent repayment and USA Federal Direct with PSLF cap. UK + USA.
- [Debt Snowball Calculator](https://finncalc.com/debt-snowball-calculator/): Multi-debt payoff with snowball (smallest balance first) vs avalanche (highest APR first) comparison.
- [FIRE Calculator](https://finncalc.com/fire-calculator/): Financial Independence / Retire Early projection with Lean, Regular, Fat, and Coast tiers and adjustable safe withdrawal rate.
- [ISA Calculator (UK)](https://finncalc.com/isa-calculator/): Stocks & Shares, Cash, and Lifetime ISA growth with the £20,000 annual allowance and 25% LISA bonus enforced.
- [TFSA Calculator (South Africa)](https://finncalc.com/tfsa-calculator/): SARS s12T tax-free savings projection with R36,000 annual + R500,000 lifetime caps enforced.

## Hub

- [All Personal Finance Calculators](https://finncalc.com/personal-finance-calculators/): Every tool grouped by category — investing, retirement, mortgage, debt, tax, budgeting, net worth.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All calculator pages support USA, UK, and South Africa via a region toggle that switches currency and tax conventions.
- Calculations run entirely client-side; no user data is transmitted.
- Educational content is original and references primary sources (HMRC, SARS, IRS, ONS, Bank of England) where applicable.
- The site is operated by James Blanckenberg and the editorial policy is published at /editorial-policy/.
